The light from the figure casts soft cyan reflections on the paper and hands of the student, whose fingertips are visible near the keyboard, blurred in the foreground. The background shows a bookshelf with faintly visible spines, out of focus. Color palette: deep blues, warm amber from a desk lamp, and cyan highlights. Lighting is a mix of warm practical light and cool digital glow, creating a sense of focused, creative collaboration between human and intelligent technology. Camera angle: slightly low, three-quarter view, shallow depth of field emphasizing the interplay between physical materials and the ethereal digital form. Realistic style with subtle futuristic tone, no text or symbols.
